title: EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN Isolated 61.8% Rejection Hardening (De-coupling Test)
research_question: Does isolating candle/MACD rejection confirmation at the 61.8% Fibonacci level (InpRequire618Rejection=true) while maintaining the standard European open (InpLondonOpen=8) reduce false breakout losses on EURUSD without sacrificing the profitable 08:00-11:00 morning trend legs?
hypothesis: Enabling InpRequire618Rejection=true while preserving InpLondonOpen=8 will selectively filter low-probability 61.8% retracements, reducing EURUSD gross losses while avoiding the 45.3% gross profit collapse caused by the 11:00 session delay in EXP-0066.

facts: In EXP-0049 (EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN baseline with InpLondonOpen=8, InpRequire618Rejection=false), the strategy produced -$371.27 net profit, PF 0.81, 74 trades, and -$1,981.54 gross loss.

In EXP-0066 (EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN bundled test), delaying London open to 11:00 and enabling InpRequire618Rejection reduced gross loss by 37.0% (-$733.33) but collapsed gross profit by 45.3% (-$729.50) due to missing European morning trends.
In EXP-0065 (GBPUSD M30), InpRequire618Rejection=true eliminated false short entries and boosted net profit to +$369.98 (PF 1.51, WR 61.11%).
inferences: The failure of EXP-0066 to improve net profit was driven by the loss of the 08:00-10:59 European morning liquidity window rather than the 61.8% rejection filter itself.
De-coupling the changes by restoring InpLondonOpen=8 and isolating InpRequire618Rejection=true should preserve morning trend participation while curbing unconfirmed retracement entries.
evidence: EXP-0066 recorded only 40 trades compared to 74 in EXP-0049, indicating that InpLondonOpen=11 was excessively restrictive for EURUSD.
EURUSD gross loss was reduced from -$1,981.54 to -$1,248.21 in EXP-0066, proving that entry filtering successfully prevented significant adverse trades.

independent_variables.name: InpRequire618Rejection
independent_variables.rationale: Requires price action confirmation (candle rejection wick ratio >= 0.35 or MACD alignment) on 61.8% Fibonacci retracement entries.

assumptions: A single primary variable change (InpRequire618Rejection) provides clean causal attribution.
EURUSD morning trend capture requires opening trading at 08:00 server time.
expected_observations: Gross profit substantially exceeds EXP-0066 ($880.77) by capturing 08:00-11:00 trend entries.
Gross loss remains lower than EXP-0049 baseline (-$1,981.54).
Profit Factor improves above 0.81 (baseline) and net profit improves beyond -$371.27.
